reason: 该插件的主要用户面向功能是为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地图像文字识别与图像工具能力：在文本模型场景下先 OCR 图片再交由模型回答，并附带多个 vision_* 工具用于图像文本定位、裁剪、长图处理与差异分析。

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过本地 Umi-OCR 为图片附件提供文字识别桥接能力，并提供 vision_* 工具用于裁剪、文本定位、配色与图像差异等操作。
summaries.en: This plugin adds image-to-text support in DeepSeek Harness using local Umi-OCR for text-only workflows and exposes vision_* tools for OCR, text-region lookup, cropping, color analysis, and image comparison tasks.

capabilities: Extracts text from chat image attachments via local Umi-OCR
Injects OCR text as additional context for text-only DeepSeek models
Calls local OCR endpoint (default 127.0.0.1) or executes a configured local CLI command
Provides vision_* tools for OCR, text localization, cropping, color analysis, and image diffing
Writes optional tool outputs/artifacts to local directories

reasons.code: README states OCR bridging: when main model is text-only, images are OCRed by local Umi-OCR and recognized text is injected as auxiliary context for the model response.
README describes optional CLI mode using a configurable executable command and temporary image/output file flow.
README lists exported vision_* tools including crop, text block detection, dominant color, and pixel diff functionality.
package.json declares optional dependency on sharp for image-processing features used by some vision tools.
